title: Context window ledger: the token budget of one request at 8192

groups.label: System prompt
groups.text: You are the support agent for Acme orders. Stay calm and only state what you can verify; check the order ID before promising anything; never invent refund timelines; escalate disputes over ¥500 to a human.
groups.note: Role, boundaries, and tone rules, resent verbatim with every request — the fixed overhead inside the window. The token count is a constructed value for the full system prompt (source text excerpted). Cut it to save money and the model loses its role and boundaries — never cut this one.

groups.label: Round 1 (question + answer)
groups.text: User: My order 20260903-0087 has not shipped for three days. Agent: I can see a restock delay at our South China warehouse; it should leave tomorrow, and I have applied a ¥10 delay coupon for you.
groups.note: Past turns pile up verbatim in messages, and every new request pays their input cost again. Round 1's key facts (order ID, coupon promise) are still needed in later turns — they cannot be dropped.

groups.label: Round 2 (question + answer)
groups.text: User: The coupon has not arrived, and I also need to change the delivery address. Agent: The coupon lands within 24 hours; the address is updated — please confirm the recipient details.
groups.note: Round 2 carries retrieved logistics and order data, so its footprint jumps — history accumulation is the main consumer of the window, and it grows faster the longer the conversation runs.

groups.label: This turn's new input
groups.text: User: Never mind the address — just refund me.
groups.note: The genuinely new content is the small part; system plus history fill most of the window — the root cause of long conversations getting pricier and slower every turn.

groups.label: Output reserve
groups.text: Your refund has been submitted and should arrive via the original payment method in 1–3 business days; the delay coupon is unaffected. Anything else I can help with?
groups.note: Output shares the window budget with input: reserving 2048 for max_tokens leaves 6144 for input; squeeze the output out and generation is truncated (finish_reason=length). All five groups sum to 7248 of the 8192 window, leaving 944.
